article.title: Google Wallet could soon put up a fight against Apple Wallet on iPhones
article.summary: TL;DR Google could be working to bring the Google Wallet app to iOS devices. Strings spotted in a couple of Google apps hint at iOS-specific features in the Wallet app. The app could offer contactless payments using the NFC chip on iPhones as well. Google Wallet has plenty of useful features : you can save loyalty cards, add passes and tickets, and make contactless payments through the app without pulling out a physical card. Google is also working on new features to improve the app and has started rolling out a redesign with full-screen passes and a better UI. Now, it seems Google is finally considering bringing Google Wallet back to iPhones. You’re reading an Authority Insights story. article.title: 超過千萬筆資料外洩的企業，韓國將罰款最高營收10%
article.summary:
韓國資料隱私主管機關個人資訊保護委員會（Personal Information Protection Committee，PIPC）上周宣布新法規，將針對因故意或重大過失造成1,000萬人以上個資外洩的企業，最高處分年營收10%的罰款。
PIPC主席Song Kyung-hee 9月9日在記者會上公布個人資訊保護法（Personal Information Protection Act）新措施自9月11日起正式實施。
